claim: The grammar records activity readings with the bus and similar expressions.
evidence_summary: Under VP ellipsis two people may go to different hospitals. Keeping the noun constant and varying its governor affects the weak reading.
finding: These tests extend the account of when the activity reading is available.
inference: Which verb–noun combinations allow a weak reading with different individual referents?

evidence.source: Natalie M. Klein, Whitney M. Gegg-Harrison, Greg N. Carlson & Michael K. Tanenhaus (2013). Experimental investigations of weak definite and weak indefinite noun phrases. Cognition 128(2), 187–213.
evidence.passage: §8.4, p. 408. The grammar records activity readings with the bus and similar expressions.
evidence.example: The experiments bear on conventional activities associated with particular verb–noun combinations.
evidence.establishes: Evidence for describing the distribution of an interpretation CGEL already records.
evidence.locator: Experimental study of weak definite and weak indefinite NPs.

evidence.example: A repeated hospital expression can pick out different hospitals for different patients.
